concept: GEMM Compute Scaling vs GEMV Memory-Bandwidth Bounds
summary: Source-anchored research for GEMM Compute Scaling vs GEMV Memory-Bandwidth Bounds. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Prompt pre-fill evaluates GEMM operations where high arithmetic intensity (FLOPs/byte > 100) saturates GPU tensor cores and scales linearly with compute clock frequencies. (high confidence)

Auto-regressive decoding executes GEMV operations with minimal arithmetic intensity (FLOPs/byte approx. 1), causing GPU compute ALUs to sit idle while awaiting memory bus DRAM/GDDR reads. (high confidence)
